title: Ana's Clothes
text:
Today it is cold and rainy. Ana wears a red coat, a hat and blue boots. She takes an umbrella too.

Tomorrow the sun will shine. Ana will wear a white shirt and shorts. She loves hot weather.

questions.text: What color is Ana's coat today?

options: A red coat and a hat
Blue boots and a black dress

questions.text: How does Ana probably feel about tomorrow's weather?
Why does Ana probably take an umbrella today?
options: Because she is going to the beach

vocabulary.definition: a warm piece of clothing worn over other clothes
an object you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain
short trousers that end above the knees
to give out bright light, like the sun

paragraph_translations: Hoje está frio e chovendo. A Ana usa um casaco vermelho, um chapéu e botas azuis. Ela também leva um guarda-chuva.
Amanhã o sol vai brilhar. A Ana vai usar uma camisa branca e shorts. Ela adora tempo quente.
